'''Palpatine's Spaarti cloning facility''', also known as '''Emperor Palpatine's personal cloning facility''' was a clandestine laboratory constructed upon the orders of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] deep within the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
Upon the orders of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], a [[Cloning/Legends|cloning facility]] was established in the bowels of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] under the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A clandestine laboratory, the facility contained several [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]s which Palpatine used for his [[essence transfer]] experiments. Before the Emperor could make use of the cloning facility to replace his own body, he was [[Battle of Endor/Legends|killed]] over the planet [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] and the Empire fell into disarray. The cloning facility was discovered by [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]], who destroyed all of the cylinders except for one, which she transferred to her [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' and used to breed a single [[Ysanne Isard (clone)|clone]] of herself.<ref name="NEGAS" />
